findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: credits_checkout, guru_moves · Private data: ai_context, intrinsic_value, smart_money_holdings, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, verdict, mirror_brief, gurus, guru, guru_portfolio, theses, indicators_buffett, indicators_shiller_pe, sentiment, news, companies_search, company_overview, fundamentals, filings · Public sink: credits_checkout, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, webhooks_list · Destructive: ai_context, theses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: credits_checkout, guru_moves · Private data: ai_context, intrinsic_value, smart_money_holdings, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, verdict, mirror_brief, gurus, guru, guru_portfolio, theses, indicators_buffett, indicators_shiller_pe, sentiment, news, companies_search, company_overview, fundamentals, filings · Public sink: credits_checkout, smart_money_changes, guru_moves, webhooks_list · Destructive: ai_context, theses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
